# sent by software

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sentBySoftware`](gmeow-sentBySoftware.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sentBySoftware>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)

The software agent that sent a message, when parsed and identified from the User-Agent or X-Mailer header. The raw header value remains on [`gmeow:userAgent`](gmeow-userAgent.md) ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).
